author: SocialAPIs
description: Facebook & Instagram data for AI agents: pages, posts, groups, Ads Library, Marketplace, profiles and reels. 47 read-only tools with structured output. Requires a SocialAPIs API key (free tier: 200 calls/month at socialapis.io).
name: SocialAPIs — Facebook & Instagram Data

tools.name: facebook_get_page_id
tools.title: Facebook: Get Page ID
tools.description: Resolve a Facebook page URL to its numeric page ID. Use it when another tool needs a page or profile ID; use facebook_get_page_details for the page's data. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

result.description: JSON response from the SocialAPIs REST endpoint, unchanged. Object or array depending on the endpoint; most include a `meta` block (statusCode, duration, creditsCharged, creditsRemaining).

creditsRemaining.description: Credits left on the API key after this call, or null if not reported.

tools.name: facebook_get_page_details
tools.title: Facebook: Get Page Details
tools.description: Get a Facebook page's profile: name, category, follower and like counts, bio, contact info (email, phone, website, address), rating and the ad_page_id used by the Ads Library tools. Use it when you have the page URL; to find a page by name, use facebook_search_pages first. Pricing: 1 credit per call; 5 credits when exact_followers_count=true.

exact_followers_count.description: When true, performs a deeper scrape to return the exact follower count (e.g. 38,493,217 instead of "38M"). Charges 5 credits when true, 1 credit otherwise. Default: false.

result.description: JSON response from the SocialAPIs REST endpoint, unchanged. Object or array depending on the endpoint; most include a `meta` block (statusCode, duration, creditsCharged, creditsRemaining).

creditsCharged.description: Credits charged for this call, or null if the endpoint did not report it.

creditsRemaining.description: Credits left on the API key after this call, or null if not reported.

tools.name: facebook_get_page_posts
tools.title: Facebook: Get Page Posts
tools.description: List a Facebook page's recent posts, newest first, with text, media, reactions, comment and share counts. Returns 3-9 posts per call plus an end_cursor for the next page; filter by date with after_time / before_time. For reels or videos only, use facebook_get_page_reels or facebook_get_page_videos. Pricing: ceil(posts_returned / 3) credits per call, minimum 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return. Default: 3. Minimum: 3. Maximum: 9.

end_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

after_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp - only return posts after this time

before_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp - only return posts before this time

result.description: JSON response from the SocialAPIs REST endpoint, unchanged. Object or array depending on the endpoint; most include a `meta` block (statusCode, duration, creditsCharged, creditsRemaining).

creditsRemaining.description: Credits left on the API key after this call, or null if not reported.

tools.name: instagram_get_profile_posts

tools.name: instagram_get_reels_feed
